rows.note: Use this as the everyday all-purpose way to report that someone claims something, especially when the context makes clear it is unproven.

example.english: They allege that the shop sells counterfeit goods, but we still need evidence.
example.traditional: 佢話間舖頭賣假貨，我哋仲要搵證據先。
example.jyutping: keoi5 waa6 gaan1 pou3 tau2 maai6 gaa2 fo3 ngo5 dei6 zung6 jiu3 wan2 zing3 geoi3 sin1

rows.note: Choose this when you want to explicitly present a claim as an allegation rather than an established fact.

example.english: They allege that they were at home throughout the night of the incident, but they cannot provide any evidence.
example.traditional: 被告聲稱案發當晚一直留喺屋企，但未能提出任何證據。
example.jyutping: bei6 gou3 sing1 cing1 on3 faat3 dong1 maan5 jat1 zik6 lau4 hai2 uk1 kei2 daan6 mei6 nang4 tai4 ceot1 jam6 ho4 zing3 geoi3
